interpretation.discovered: Repository was found through a declared discovery source; discovery alone does not authorize deep monitoring.
interpretation.deep_monitored: Repository is admitted as included at core or related tier and receives full activity collection.
interpretation.watch_monitored: Repository is admitted at watch tier and receives repository metadata plus release signals only.
interpretation.inventory_only: Repository is retained for scope provenance but receives no routine activity collection.
